CDX2-positive (CDX2+) circulating tumour cells can be detected in the peripheral blood of colorectal cancer ( CRC ) patients using a refined immunoenrichment (IE) assay.

CDX2 positive circulating tumor cells (CDX2 p-CTCs) were detected in 80.9% (73 out of the 90) patients with colorectal cancer ( CRC) using the refined immunomagnetic (IM) enrichment assay, but not in the patients with benign colorectal diseases, other cancers and normal subjects; and the numbers of CDX2 p- CTCs were associated with the clinicopathological factors, and recurrence and survival in patients with CRC.
